cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That cupboard leans exactly like your first one. I thought my lesson about checking the back panel had stuck.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the instructions this time. I don't need another lesson.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good progress. Which page says to leave the door leaning against the wall?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just hold the door while I fit the hinges?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's the useful bit of my lesson: asking for help. Try that request again without 'just.'

reason: Preserve the useful Drive exchange while replacing generic training prefaces with specific corrections, qualified praise and claimed influence that make the mentor role determine A's tactic.
